corrections.beforeEn: lay someone down; pour a liquid
corrections.beforeEs: acostar a alguien; verter un líquido
corrections.usageNoteEn: This card selects the documented liquid-into-a-container sense only. Other meanings of the same written form are not taught by this card.
corrections.usageNoteEs: Esta tarjeta selecciona únicamente la acepción documentada de verter un líquido en un recipiente. No enseña las otras acepciones de la misma forma escrita.
corrections.evidence: User selected the independently documented second sense: pouring water or another liquid into a vessel. Primary PDF432 TĒCA sense2 checked; original mixed record and source evidence remain unchanged. This is a selected sense, not a euphemistic replacement.

corrections.usageNoteEn: This card selects old clothing no longer used for dressing, as documented in sense 2. It does not teach the separate diaper sense.
corrections.usageNoteEs: Esta tarjeta selecciona la ropa vieja que ya no se usa para vestir, documentada en la acepción 2. No enseña la acepción separada de pañal.
corrections.evidence: User selected the live IDIEZ definition's independently documented second meaning: old clothing no longer used for dressing. The source definition and original mixed bilingual record remain intact; no diaper image or relabeling of that first sense is authorized.

corrections.meaningEs: un alimento causa dolor de estómago
corrections.usageNoteEn: This card selects IHTICOCOĀ sense 2 only: food causes a person stomach pain. The separately documented person-inflicted injury meaning is excluded.
corrections.usageNoteEs: Esta tarjeta selecciona únicamente la acepción 2 de IHTICOCOĀ: un alimento causa dolor de estómago a una persona. Se excluye la acepción distinta de lesión causada por otra persona.
corrections.evidence: Primary physical PDF page246 explicitly numbers sense1 person/animal striking the abdomen and sense2 food-caused stomach pain. Sense2 uses the experiencer frame nech and prints nechihticocoh with a food stimulus. Select only that independently documented meaning; preserve original mixed fact record, source identity and evidence.
